_doc: Shared fixture for the Go server (server/internal/library) and the web client (web/src/app/core/textutil.ts).
Both implementations must produce exactly these results. Cases without a 'fix' field reproduce the behaviour of the
former Python/JS reader (since removed). Cases WITH a 'fix' field are deliberate changes (bugs.md id).
RULES
strip(s) removes WS from both ends. naturalTitle(s) = strip(stripChars(strip(s), '-:. ')).
parseChapterName(file): name = NFC(file). Must end with '.txt' (case-insensitive); stem = name without it. Grammar on stem,
case-insensitive, anchored at both ends:
[ VOLWORD WS+ DIGITS WS* [-:.,\u2013]? WS* ]  ('Quyển'|'Quyen'|'Tập'|'Tap')  -> vol
('Chương'|'Chuong') WS+ DIGITS                                              -> n
[ ('.'|'-') DIGITS  only when followed by WS or end of stem ]               -> sub
WS* [-:.\u2013]? WS* REST                                                  -> title = naturalTitle(REST)
DIGITS = one or more Unicode decimal digits (\p{Nd}), at most 15, value taken digit by digit.
Result {n, title, sub, vol}; sub and vol are 0 when absent. null when no match.
In API JSON a chapter is {n, title, file} plus 'sub'/'vol' only when non-zero. 'file' is the ORIGINAL name.
chapterList(files): parse every name, drop non-matches, sort by (vol, n, sub, file) with 'file' compared by code point;
then de-duplicate: entries with equal (vol, n, sub) AND equal compact(title) keep only the first in sort order.
compact(s) = normKey(s) with spaces removed. Different titles under one number are all kept.
cleanChapterText(text, n?): 1) CRLF/CR -> LF, strip leading U+FEFF. 2) RULE = ^WS*[=\-_*]{5,}WS*$. Among the first 8 lines
collect indexes of RULE lines; a header block exists when there are >= 2, the second is <= 4 lines after the first, AND every
line before the first is blank (strip == ''). Then title = non-empty stripped lines between them joined by one space (if any)
and the lines up to and including the second rule are dropped. 3) Each remaining line: collapse runs of space/tab to one space,
strip; drop empty; a RULE line becomes the scene-break paragraph '***'. 4) If title is still null and the first paragraph
matches ^(Chương|Chuong)WS+DIGITS (case-insensitive) and has < 160 code points, and (n is not given OR the number equals n),
pop it as the title. 5) Scene breaks: drop leading, trailing and consecutive-duplicate '***'.
Result {title|null, paragraphs}.
chapterJson(text, file): p = parseChapterName(file); {title, paragraphs} = cleanChapterText(text, p ? p.n : undefined);
if title is empty and p: title = (p.vol ? 'Quyển '+p.vol+' - ' : '') + 'Chương ' + p.n + (p.sub ? '.'+p.sub : '') + (p.title ? ': '+p.title : '').
words = number of WS-separated tokens over paragraphs other than '***'.
normTxt(s): String(s||'') -> NFD -> remove U+0300-036F -> replace đ/Đ with d -> lower-case. (unchanged from app.js)
normKey(s): normTxt(s), then every run of characters that are not Unicode letters/digits becomes one space, then trim.
Search matches when every query token (normKey(q) split on space) is a substring of normKey(field) or of compact(field).
infoSummary(info, fallback): info that is not a JSON object is treated as {}. text(v) = v if non-empty string; decimal string if
integer number; else null. name = text(info.name) || fallback; author = text(author.name if object else author);
synopsis = text(synopsis) || text(description) || ''; poster: object -> ['600'] || ['default'] || first value; string kept, else null;
genres/tags = names of array items that are objects with a non-empty string name (non-array -> []);
status = text(status_name) || text(state); declared_chapters = integer number, or integer parsed from an all-digit string, else null;
link = text(link).
pickCover(names): images = names with extension .jpg .jpeg .png .webp .gif .avif (case-insensitive) sorted by code point; first whose
lower-case stem is cover, then poster, folder, thumb; else the first image; else null.
